content.title: Browse bouquet catalogue and view bouquet prices before adding to the basket
content.intent: Prove that a visitor can browse bouquet listings and see each bouquet's price before taking any basket action, including on a phone-sized browser.
content.technique_notes: Derived with equivalence partitioning over viewport classes for the same expected outcome: default browser and phone-sized browser. covering_array reported strength=1 (degraded from 2: only 1 input(s))), so the scenario enumerates the single input's representative values as parameters rather than splitting outcome-identical paths. Responsiveness was included because the source explicitly says the flow must work on a phone; negative, BVA, a11y, perf, and i18n did not mint separate paths because the source states no invalid-input behavior, bounds, accessibility promise, performance threshold, or locale-dependent rule for catalogue browsing.

judgements.rationale: [applicability] Applicable because viewport is an input condition with two representative classes—default browser and phone-sized browser—while the expected browse-and-see-price outcome stays the same.
[applicability] Applicable because the source explicitly requires that the flow work on a phone, making phone-sized rendering a grounded coverage condition.
[applicability] Not applicable for a distinct scenario because the source does not define any invalid browse input, rejection behavior, or expected failure mode for catalogue discovery.
[applicability] Not applicable because the source gives no numeric, date, or length bounds for catalogue browsing or price visibility.
[applicability] Not minted because the evidence does not promise accessibility semantics such as labels, keyboard support, or screen-reader behavior for this use case.
[applicability] Not minted because the evidence gives no latency or performance threshold for catalogue browsing on the storefront.
[applicability] Not minted because the evidence gives no locale, translation, or formatting requirement for catalogue browsing or price display.
